method: Fastify injection, real opaque cookie/CSRF, runtime SQL, Auth verification and JWT PostgREST; excludes browser and client TCP/TLS. Four independently signed-in users, 4 concurrent requests, 4 warmups then 12 measured requests per read. Imports: 3 sequential 100-row jobs and one 4-job concurrent burst. Timings are warm local engineering observations, not an SLA. No p99 claim.
